versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the altcoin-season skill.
- Provides a real-time Altcoin Season Index measuring capital rotation from BTC to altcoins.
- Connects directly to APEX Runner’s autonomous trading system (Kraken, Coinbase Advanced Trade, Hyperliquid).
- Requires only an EVM wallet (USDC on Base mainnet); no API key or subscription needed.
- Offers tiered, pay-per-call pricing with automatic discounts for early adopters.
